meta.name: content-refresher
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "update outdated content" or "fix traffic/ranking decay"; scores decay, prioritizes refresh work, and produces an update plan with GEO and republishing guidance. Not for net-new content — use seo-content-writer. 内容更新/排名恢复

copy.tagline: 识别并更新掉队内容，恢复搜索排名
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有内容流量下滑，需要系统化刷新和重新发布
copy.tagline_en: Identify and refresh decaying content to restore search rankings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your existing content is losing traffic and needs systematic updates and republishing

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析旧内容，找出过时信息、流量下降等问题，然后生成一份更新计划，包括具体修改建议、GEO优化和重新发布策略。
howto.when: 当你要求更新过时内容、修复流量下降的文章，或给现有内容补充新信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我刷新这篇博客文章，更新到2025年。
say.note: Claude 会分析文章并给出更新计划。

say.text: 找出我网站上流量下降最多的页面。
say.note: Claude 会识别需要刷新的候选页面。

say.text: 更新这个内容，让它超过竞争对手的排名。
say.note: Claude 会制定超越对手的刷新策略。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes old content, identifies outdated info, traffic drops, etc., and generates an update plan with specific edits, GEO optimization, and republishing strategy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to update outdated content, fix declining traffic articles, or add new info to existing content.

say_en.text: Refresh this blog post and update it to 2025.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and produce an update plan.

say_en.text: Find pages on my site that have lost the most traffic.
Update this content to outrank the competitor.
say_en.note: Claude will create a strategy to beat competitors.
